meta.deliverable: NFRA_COMPTEAM B1 -- portal-surface -> data-source map (TSGRAPH PanelCluster + SERVED_FROM/FIRM_CONFIG, grounded vs live served, cadence-aware)
meta.status: v0.2 -- STATIC tier fully grounded+live+cadence-aware; DYNAMIC tier grounded (FIRM-LEVEL live-confirmed across bd/cot/inf, PER-ENTITY pattern-resolved, TAIL enumerated for v0.3)
meta.grounding: comp-cluster live Kuzu (nessie HEAD current 2026-07-01T04:45Z) + SERVED_FROM (static) + comp-platinum tab-audit / advisor-intelligence endpoints FIRM_CONFIG (dynamic); live-confirm via comp-freshness (2026-07-01); CMA cadence Andrew-confirmed yearly.

method.DYNAMIC: endpoint/rqk -> relative platinum key (comp-platinum tab-audit + advisor-intelligence endpoints); firm prefix selects opal-data-{bd,cot,inf}; FIRM-LEVEL live-confirmed across all 3 firms; PER-ENTITY parameterized by {id}.
method.cadence: expected_cadence per artifact (yearly CMA ... nightly platinum ... daily portal-v2); stale = past ITS OWN cadence.

findings.detail: Served past ITS OWN cadence. (non_model_assets = 49F/Schwab freeze -> folds into MDPF basis-switch per COO.)
CapitalMarketAssumptions views.json/assumptions.json -- Andrew-confirmed YEARLY cadence; ~6mo age is INTENTIONAL, NOT stale. Cadence-aware verdict prevents the false-FAIL.

SERVED_FROM grounds only the 29 static ServedURLs. The DYNAMIC tier (Lambda-mediated ADVI/PM/MDPF) is grounded in v0.2 via comp-platinum tab-audit + the advisor-intelligence endpoints map (FIRM_CONFIG -> opal-data-{bd,cot,inf}/platinum), NOT via the graph. RECOMMEND: enrich TSGRAPH with Endpoint->artifact edges (the FIRM_CONFIG map IS the enrichment input) so grounding is fully graph-native for B2.

Freshness verdict is now cadence-aware: stale = past the artifact's OWN expected_cadence (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly/event-driven), not a blanket 48h threshold. Slow-cadence served artifacts (yearly CMA) no longer false-FAIL -- this is what makes AC-3's live-grounded flag actionable. For CTO spec-gate: adopt expected_cadence as a first-class map field + a cadence registry per served artifact.
